title: Step-by-Step Configuration Guide for Zscaler Cloud Connector

blocks.text: This guide takes you through the configuration steps you need to complete before using Zscaler Cloud Connector for your organization.
Before you begin configuring Cloud Connector, Zscaler recommends reading the following articles:
